title: European Golden Shoe winners, 2016/17 to 2025/26
brief: Name the winner of the European Golden Shoe, for the top league scorer in Europe, in each season from 2016/17 to 2025/26.

notes.Luis Suarez: Luis Suarez won in 2013/14 (shared with Ronaldo) and 2015/16, outside these years.
notes.Cristiano Ronaldo: Cristiano Ronaldo won in 2007/08, 2010/11, 2013/14 (shared) and 2014/15, outside these years.
notes.Thierry Henry: Thierry Henry won in 2003/04 and 2004/05, outside these years.
notes.Diego Forlan: Diego Forlan won in 2004/05 (shared) and 2008/09, outside these years.

checks: Every winner and goal tally agrees between Wikipedia's European Golden Shoe list and RSSSF's Golden Boot list (RSSSF lists one name for a shared year; Wikipedia, France Football's record, shows Henry and Forlan sharing 2004/05). Kane's 2025/26 award (36 goals, 72 points) is confirmed by Bayern and bundesliga.com (August 2026). The 4-slot rule was tested for every ten-season window from 2000/01: windows starting 2000/01 to 2004/05 and 2013/14 to 2016/17 pass; windows starting 2005/06 to 2012/13 fail, because Messi or Ronaldo would fill four or more slots.
